title: 2-bed apartment, Drumcondra, Dublin 3
description: Two-bedroom first-floor apartment in Drumcondra, close to DCU and the city centre bus routes. Double and single bedroom, open-plan kitchen and living room, gas heating, BER C1. Unfurnished, long-term let. Viewings on Saturday from 11am to 1pm at the property; call or email to book a slot. References from a previous landlord and an employer are required. The lease is signed in person with the letting agent, and the tenancy will be registered with the RTB.
